data.segment_title: Preview/Introduction Tom Brokaw (Democratic National Convention in Boston)
Decision 2004 / Democratic Convention / Kerry / Undecided Voters
data.segment_description:
(Boston: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Convention floor: Brian Williams) Senator John Kerry’s appearance tonight at the Democratic National Convention, where he will accept the nomination for president, featured; scenes shown of Kerry biking in Boston and testing the podium; excerpts from Kerry’s speech quoted; details given of last night’s unscripted speech by Rev. Al Sharpton, who sharply criticized President Bush’s administration. [Political analyst Lawrence O’DONNELL††- says voters don’t love Kerry.] [Last night, SHARPTON – says “our vote is not for sale.”] [Last night, Senator John EDWARDS – says “hope is on the way.”] 
 (Boston: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Canton, Ohio: Ron Allen) The fight for undecided voters in Ohio featured. [At Kent State University Stark Campus, swing voters Jennifer BOWER‡, Anita JACKSON, Phil ELAM‡, Julie FARLEY‡ Bob PHILLIPS, Derek BRANDON‡– react to Edwards’s speech last night.]

(Boston: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced.   (Washington: Pete Williams) The capture in Pakistan of Tanzanian-born Al Qaeda operative Ahmed Ghailani†, who is wanted for the 1998 bombings of US embassies in Africa, featured; scenes shown from Gujrat, where Ghailani was arrested. [In May, FBI director Robert MUELLER – asks for public help in finding Ghailani and another bombing suspect.]

(Boston: Tom Brokaw) Militants’ threat to kill 7 foreign truck drivers held hostage in Iraq; funerals for victims of yesterday’s car bombing in Baquba, and the postponement of a conference of Iraqi leaders who were to elect a national assembly noted; video shown of an Indian man held at gunpoint; scenes shown from Baquba.   (Boston: Andrea Mitchell) The Saudi Arabian proposal to create a Muslim military force to replace US forces in Iraq examined; map shown of countries that might participate; details given of the Saudi fear that the insurgency in Iraq could spread to Saudi Arabia and threaten the royal family; scenes shown of Secretary of State Colin Powell with Saudi leaders and with interim Iraqi Prime Minister Iyad Allawi; militant group’s threat to attack a Muslim force quoted. [POWELL – says we welcome the Saudi initiative and will examine it.] [ALLAWI – calls on leaders of Islamic & Arab countries to close ranks.] [Iraq expert Daniel BRUMBERG†- says this will provoke retaliation from Al Qaeda & its affiliates.] [Senator Joseph BIDEN – says we need more forces and less of an American face.] Saudi pressure on the US to beef up security along their border with Iraq noted.

data.segment_description:
(Boston: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Boston: Campbell Brown) The Republicans’ “war room” in Boston, where the Republican rapid response team is trying to take some of the spotlight off the Democratic National Convention, featured; details given of the Republican message that the convention is an “extreme makeover” for presidential candidate Senator John Kerry. [Republican National Committee spokesman Jim DYKE†- admits it’s not easy to break through in the midst of thousands of Democrats.] [In TV interviews, former New York City Mayor Rudolph GIULIANI – comments on Kerry’s makeover.] [Tuesday, Senator Edward KENNEDY – says “may none but the honest & wise ever rule under this roof.”] [Bush-Cheney rapid response director Matt McDONALD†- describes the immediate delivery to the media of attacks against the Democrats.] 
 (Boston: Tom Brokaw) More coverage of the convention on msnbc.com noted.

(Boston: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Lancaster, Texas: Jim Cummins) Flash flooding in Texas featured; scenes shown of floodwaters & damage and of the rescue of a teenager caught in rushing water. [Lancaster police department Lt. Jim DEVLIN†- cites the number of flooded-out homes.] [Teen’s friend Brandon BORD‡, Ft. Worth fireman Gene BYRD‡- comment on the rescue.]

data.segment_description:
(Boston: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Boston: Tom Costello) The negative economic impact for Boston merchants of the Democratic National Convention featured; scenes shown of Boston leaders in 2002 cheering the news that the city was chosen as the site for the convention; details given of the impact of the tight security. [Francesca’s Restaurant assistant chef Fernando PEREIRA†- says business has been slow.] [Monica’s Restaurant owner George MENDOZA†- says they have managed to keep people away from Boston.] [Boston Mayor Thomas MENINO††- says it’s about the economic impact in the out years 
 (‡).] [New York Host Committee president Kevin SHEEKEY†- comments on avoiding similar problems for the upcoming Republican convention.] 
 (Boston: Tom Brokaw) The expectation that Teresa Heinz Kerry & Elizabeth Edwards, wives of the Democratic candidates, will take prominent roles in the pursuit of women’s votes and the strategic role of the spouse noted.
